  2. Create `xbmc/test/MockSettingsComponent.h` — gmock mock of CSettingsComponent (the #2 most-included service after ServiceBroker itself)

  **What NOT to do:**
  - Don't modify CServiceBroker itself — the stub works alongside it
  - Don't mock everything — only Settings and Profile for now. Other mocks come in later beads.
  - Don't create a parallel service registration system — use the existing CServiceBroker static methods
